mcq.q: Why does Selina want articles about the weather?
o: She saw a lot of stormy weather on her island.
She loves shopping in the rain.
She wants to be an inventor.
She went hiking in the snow.
mcq.why: Her stormy summer made her want to know why the weather is changing.

mcq.q: Which reason best shows why a topic is good for a school magazine?
o: Many students are interested in it.
mcq.why: A good magazine topic interests many readers.
